result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. The main visual defect is a duplicated restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel; a couple of minor cosmetic points were also noted.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows the same restaurant twice: two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same image, delivery time (15–25 min) and delivery fee (€0.90) appear side by side.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate items in the carousel data source (e.g., by restaurant ID) so each restaurant appears only once.

issues.description: The two 'Green Bowl Poké' cards use what appears to be a generic placeholder-style illustration on a plain gray background, which contrasts with the richer photographic imagery of other cards (burger, ramen, pizza) and makes the row look inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Use real restaurant/dish photos for all carousel cards, or apply a consistent fallback image style when photos are missing.
